text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having lost to Mr. C.B. last time, Eishin Flash cannot hide her anxiety upon meeting her again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, I tell her how setbacks are a valuable experience that benefit her in the long run. She puts her faith in my words and heads to the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she loses the race, Mr. C.B. acknowledges her abilities and confirms that she has improved.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her schedule through to completion has borne fruit. Eishin Flash regains confidence in her current abilities and sets her determined gaze upon the Osaka Hai.
